title: Everything You Need to Copy Winning LP Strategies
description: From discovering profitable liquidity providers to fully automating your copy strategies, YieldSync gives you everything you need to stay ahead on Meteora.

features.title: Non-Custodial
features.description: Your funds stay under your control. Wallets are securely created and managed through Privy's trusted wallet infrastructure, with no need to share private keys or give up ownership of your assets.

features.title: Wallet Intelligence
features.description: Discover high-performing LP wallets using YieldSync Wallet Intel or your favorite on-chain analytics tools.

features.title: Automated Copy Trading
features.description: Automatically mirror liquidity actions from the wallets you choose—without constant monitoring.

features.title: Multiple Strategies
features.description: Create independent copy strategies with dedicated wallets, custom filters, and individual allocations.

features.title: Built for Meteora
features.description: Designed for Meteora liquidity providers with native support for DLMM and DAMM V2 strategies.

features.title: Full Control
features.description: Pause, edit, or stop your strategies at any time. You decide which wallets to follow and how your capital is allocated.
